tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search Agent Stack Directory for AI agent infrastructure tools by keyword, with optional category and open-source filters. Omit query to list every tool in a category.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Get the full listing for one tool by slug or name: summary, official site, open-source flag, last link check, and the alternatives in its category.

tools.name: compare
tools.description: Compare 2 to 4 tools side by side by slug or name. Returns a table, notable differences and the head-to-head page when one exists.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List every category (layer of the agent stack) with its key, description and tool counts.
